## What is slow at the moment

     templates" is a better problem statement than "template picker" — it says
     how much time is being lost and why. -->

## What you would want to happen

<!-- Including what it should say out loud when it works, and what it should

## Does REAPER or SWS already do this?

<!-- Worth a look in the action list first. If a native action does the work
     but says nothing, that is still a good issue — the script that speaks the
     result is the useful part, and it can be chained after the native action
     in a custom action. -->

## Anything it must not do

<!-- Especially: anything it should leave alone. A script that changes more
     than you expected is much worse than one that does too little, because
     the difference is silent. -->
